signal: Monograph published its 2026 A&E Business Benchmarks Report showing AI-using firms post stronger revenue per employee, and is running a benchmark webinar

email.body1:
Tyler, saw Monograph's 2026 A&E Benchmarks report make the case that AI-using firms post stronger revenue per employee.

That data gives you reason to reach a lot more A&E firms than reps can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Monograph off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tyler, quick follow-up for Monograph.

With 750-plus firms already on board and the benchmark driving demand, named accounts per rep grow fast, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Monograph needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tyler, last bit of proof for Monograph.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Monograph's reply rate likely compares to similar vertical-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tyler, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a VP's calendar rarely cooperates.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a vertical-SaaS motion? I will tailor it to Monograph either way.
